messages:
Anya: kicking off a dashboard to compare baseline vs canary across runtime + infra signals. first pass: what's absolutely required vs optional?

Mike: minimal = requests_per_s, p50_ms, p95_ms, error_rate (4xx/5xx), kv_cache_hit, inflight_batches, gpu_util%

Ravi: add cost_per_request (tokens * unit_cost) and sample_ratio for sampled traffic. normalization is critical or comparisons lie.

Jess: paging rules: don't page on small variance. suggestion: page if p95_delta > 15% AND p95 > prod_slo for routes marked critical, otherwise slack-notify + create ticket.

Oliver: UX: comparison widget should let you group by route_policy or model_variant, toggle smoothing (raw/1m/5m), and overlay deploy events.

telemetry-bot: note: route_policy tag currently missing for mobile SDK requests. recommend instrumenting SDKs before wide rollout.

Anya: we'll add a metric route_tag_missing_pct so we can track coverage during canaries.

Mike: fallback_total should be broken down by fallback_reason (capacity|model_error|timeout) to speed triage.

Ravi: watch cardinality on route_policy values. i can add labels in two sprints but need a whitelist of expected values.

Jess: regression composite: if p95_delta > threshold AND eval_mismatch_rate (intent_drop) increases, escalate faster.

Anya: include sample_count table per bucket and an export CSV for postmortems (route_policy, model_variant, quant, sample_n, metrics).

telemetry-bot: starter promql for p95 by route: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route_policy))

Oliver: will upload a mock layout to the design board today. include left column: baseline vs treatment panels; right column: infra inputs + annotations.

Ravi: we also need a fallback_count_by_reason metric: rate(fallbacks_total[5m]) by (fallback_reason, route_policy)

deploy-bot: Canary started for rollout/2026-03-canary-quantized at 2026-03-05T11:07:12Z

Anya: action items: eng-runtime -> add route_policy + fallback_reason labels (Ravi). telemetry -> expose cost_per_request, sample_ratio, route_tag_missing_pct (telemetry-bot). eng-platform -> build dashboard + CSV export + toggles (Anya/Oliver). SRE -> finalize paging thresholds by route (Jess/Mike). We'll sync Monday standup for sign-off :thumbsup:
